solvedBy: Kogoro Mouri (partially on his own, the rest via Conan)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yuji Yonezawa. The actual weapon was the frozen bread dough from his shop. He avenged the old soba shop owner who was harassed to death by Kusumi to make him leave the alley. He wanted to frame Fumio because she was about to leave the alley even though the old man was her mentor.

summary.en: At the Italian Izakaya “RESO” located in Beika Gourmet Restaurant Street, Kogoro and Conan are enjoying the tasty pizza baked by Takashi Yamaura, the owner of the restaurant and Kogoro’s acquaintance. Yamaura tells Conan the time Kogoro caught a person who dined and dashed at the restaurant, the way he threw the person so hard that it left a trace on the wall. As Yamaura is about to show the trace, hidden behind by the restaurant’s menu, an excavator strikes at the restaurant, injuring him in the process.
